detail.en: IATA advises against transporting snub-nosed dogs in hot season.
detail.fr: L'IATA déconseille le transport des chiens au museau écrasé en saison chaude.
detail.es: La IATA desaconseja transportar perros de hocico chato en temporada calurosa.
detail.pt: A IATA desaconselha o transporte de cães de focinho achatado em época quente.

source.quote: Transport of snub nose dogs, such as boxers, pugs, bulldogs and Pekinese, in hot season is not recommended.

detail.en: Acceptance of snub-nosed (brachycephalic) breeds is not guaranteed on British Airways: IAG Cargo, BA's animal carrier, decides case by case — confirmation from the IAG Cargo pet travel agent is required before booking.
detail.fr: L'acceptation des races brachycéphales (museau écrasé) n'est pas garantie sur British Airways : IAG Cargo, le transporteur animalier de BA, décide au cas par cas — la confirmation de l'agent animalier IAG Cargo est obligatoire avant de réserver.
detail.es: La aceptación de razas braquicéfalas (hocico chato) no está garantizada en British Airways: IAG Cargo, el transportista de animales de BA, decide caso por caso; es obligatoria la confirmación del agente de viajes de mascotas de IAG Cargo antes de reservar.
detail.pt: A aceitação de raças braquicefálicas (focinho achatado) não é garantida na British Airways: a IAG Cargo, transportadora de animais da BA, decide caso a caso — a confirmação do agente de viagens de animais da IAG Cargo é obrigatória antes de reservar.

source.quote: Some dangerous dog breeds and snub nosed breeds of cats and dogs may not be accepted.
